name: Armuña de Almanzora (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a white middle stripe of double width, charged at the centre with a green disc bearing five white olive flowers.
history: Authorised by the Junta de Andalucía in September 1994, the symbols were adopted in July 2007; the flag is a rectangular cloth of proportions 1:2 divided horizontally into three stripes, the central white one of double width, the outer ones blue, with a green circle at the centre bearing the five olive flowers of the arms.

features.role: disc with five white olive flowers
